justification.text: 2 / √3 is the problem's constant 2/√3 in |A| ≤ (1+o(1))·(2/√3)·N^{1/2}; its divisor Real.sqrt 3 is a positive constant, so no x/0 arises.
`Finset.Icc 1 N` is the docstring's 'A ⊆ {1, ..., N}', both endpoints included.
